_notChunked.description: private field to keep track whether to avoid using chunked Transfer-Encoding for the {@link HttpRequest}

_headers.description: The internally used case-insensitive HTTP headers.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code (200, 400, etc) from the remote server.

reasonPhrase.description: The HTTP status reason phrase ("OK", "Bad Request", etc).

request.description: The original request this response corresponds to.

elapsedMs.description: The time in milliseconds that sending the request and reading the response took.
